senses.gloss: f. (זמם) the refutation of witnesses by proving an alibi, contrad. to הכחשה counterevidence; the conviction of false witnesses (Deut. XIX, 19).
units: B. Mets. 4ᵃ בתורת ה׳ subject to the law of hăzamah.
<cite ref="Ketubot 20a:5">Keth. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ שלא בפניהן</he> evidence of an alibi taken in the absence of the witnesses concerned.
<cite ref="Makkot 2a:5">Macc. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>דין ה׳</he> the punishment for evidence disproved by an alibi (retaliation); a. e.
